# FLX-3715: a consumer query or registry derives more requirements than the engine reads

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

Each literal a query compares a column with (each member of an IN list, each bound, each pattern) is one requirement the copy must hold, and each is counted on the run. A query derives at most 256 requirements and a registry at most 10,000, and past either the registry is refused before any count is built. The message names the query. Shorten the IN list, or split the query.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3715
```
